description:
Russell Brand reacts to the deeply disturbing exposure of WHO tetanus vaccines administered in Kenya that were found to contain ingredients linked to birth sterilisation and population control. Russell breaks down what the evidence revealed about the true nature of the programme and what it means when one of the world's most powerful health institutions is caught using a routine vaccination campaign as a vehicle for controlling the reproductive rights of an entire population without their knowledge or consent. A conversation about who the WHO is really working for and why this story should concern every single person on the planet.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand and Dave react to the media's overwhelming celebration of a South Asian mayor becoming the first of his kind in a UK town questioning why the coverage focuses entirely on race rather than merit or policy. Russell and Dave argue that this kind of forced diversity narrative does a disservice to everyone involved reducing a person to their ethnicity rather than their actual qualifications and achievements while the media uses it as a distraction from the real issues facing ordinary British people. A conversation about what genuine representation should look like and why manufacturing diversity for headlines helps nobody.

author: Russell Brand
description:
Russell Brand reacts to the alarming spread of the Ebola virus from Africa to America and breaks down why the official narrative around how it is being handled feels deeply familiar. Russell questions whether the global elite are once again positioning a viral outbreak as a tool for control drawing direct parallels to the way Covid was used to reshape society and strip ordinary people of their freedoms. With the same institutions that managed the Covid response now overseeing the Ebola situation Russell asks the question nobody in mainstream media will dare to ask — is this happening by accident or by design?
